main_text.l: Persia: velim quae tanti Regni Politiam
hujus regni interiora. Hoc te facturum
am sic praestiturum; finem tandem scri-
bendi faciam, si prius, ut plurimum me
REverende mi Pater ad calcem Penta-

page.notes: The right side of the scan carries a dark blurred band and speckling from the neighbouring page or scanner shadow; this is not printed text and is omitted. "disjunctè" is doubtful (marked [?]). "Congrega-gationis" is copied as printed, with the line-end hyphen; it may be a printing error for "Congregationis". Long s is rendered as s throughout. The "ut" in the lower right is the catchword for the next page.
